summary: This directory acts as the primary access point for the application's design system and user interface layer, providing a unified export strategy for shared UI components, layout structures, and specialized form-related interaction elements.
responsibilities: Consolidate and export shared user interface components
Provide a centralized access point for layout structures and form controls
Maintain the public interface for the component library
relationships: The index module acts as a central registry that aggregates exports from the form, layout, and general UI component directories.
Centralized exports allow the application to consume UI elements and layout abstractions through a single, consistent entry point.
designDecisions: Centralized barrel export pattern for improved API discoverability
Categorization of UI elements into functional groupings like layout and forms
Separation of concerns by aggregating distinct UI domains into a single package entry point
